period.question: What is the period of $y=3\sin(2x)$?
period.explanation: One full wave of $\sin(bx)$ takes $2\pi/|b|$. With $b=2$ the period is $\pi\approx3.14$. The factor 3 only changes the height of the wave (the amplitude), not its length.

sine-range.question: What is the range of $y=2\sin(x)+1$?
sine-range.explanation: The midline is $y=1$ and the amplitude is 2, so the graph runs from $1-2=-1$ up to $1+2=3$. In the notation above, the range is $[D-|R|,\,D+|R|]=[-1,3]$.
